title: Choosing a Parts filter narrows the list on that page
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Parts pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Parts area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open a Parts list page that has a filter button (for example Inventory).
2. Open a filter button and choose one value.
expected: 1. The table updates to show only the rows that match the chosen filter value.
2. The chosen value is shown on the filter button so you can see what is applied.

3. Behaviour to confirm — pending Branko's product write-up; to be checked live once the feature is available. (exactly which filters apply on which Parts page, the full option lists, and whether results update immediately).
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11884-16885 (Parts filters); design-notes.md §B.5
notes: BEHAVIOUR case — design does not pin how Parts filters apply. Pending Branko's PRD; VIU-confirm on the build. Tech plan 2026-07-29 (engineering intent - confirm live at the wording/behaviour pass): rollout rule - every Parts page gets all three together: the chip design, shareable links, and per-user remembered filters, with NO change to what is filterable; date columns use the date-range chip (see FLT-RPTS-23) and each view keeps its own state (see FLT-PERS-05).
